title: DesignDay Blr — Low Tolerance for Bullshit
description:
Low tolerance to Bullshit

Every designer has been there, experienced that at some point of time in their careers or even life in general. People who barely understand design playing critique for a design solution and jumping on to quick judgment and irrelevant feedback without the knowledge of relevant process that has gone in coming up with the solution.

This Design Day Sameer throws some insight into how to dodge bullshit and make your argument heard in a way that is most beneficial to all the stakeholders in the room.

About the speaker:

With over 15 years of experience sameer believes in applying design principles to solve various problems along with deep understanding of business and technology.

Sameer is also passionate about helping others and believes that this is the best way to learn. Sameer is one of the UX mentors at the Designlab, delivering lectures and lessons via online courses.

Ideal participant profile

Design day is focussed clearly for practising designers and design enthusiasts who are serious about making a difference in design scene in India.

This specific event is best suited for any practising designer specially young designers and beginners who work in solo or small teams and deal with corporate critique every now and then.

Do not attend if you are looking

1. For a saturday timepass.

2. Network for fun.

3. Marketing your company or product.

4. platform for hiring and recruitment

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

DesignDay is a monthly event that brings together designers from multidisciplinary backgrounds to a common platform in order to interact and learn from each other.

The agenda includes:
1. An Inspiration Design Story by a well-experienced designer to walk us through the trials and tribulations of their career in design.
2. A Skill Building Session by a mid-career designer to teach us something new using real world examples and case studies.
3. A Jam by you and fellow participants (in groups) to come up with some design suggestions based on a given topic in 1.5 to 2 hours.
